primitive.source: unchanged core.py functions finalize_mesh/project/raster_surface/dense_path/visible_points; no render(lamp) call
primitive.filter: scipy.ndimage.maximum_filter default origin=0 and mode=reflect; impulse must show offsets (0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)

geometry.plane_equation: z = z0 + sx*x + sy*y in camera/world coordinates
geometry.stroke_output: vertical center x=32+phase, endpoints y=12+phase and52+phase; straight 3D segment on rear plane

oracle.raster_sample_coordinates: High-resolution integer (x,y), exactly those used by core.raster_surface. Optical rays ((x-64)/128,(y-64)/128,1).
oracle.analytic_depth: z0/(1-sx*ray_x-sy*ray_y), only positive rays within owning finite projected patch; independent of triangle z buffer
oracle.coverage: Centered finite vertical screen rectangle, width2 high-res units (=1 output px), butt caps at projected endpoints; closed inequalities with numerical eps1e-9. This is point-sampled coverage, NOT continuous area coverage.
oracle.visibility: Footprint AND valid owner-patch hit AND owner depth equals independent nearest scene depth to1e-9. Foreground ties absent by design.
oracle.matched_footprint_diagnostic: Also form legacy pre-z deposits and their inherited width stencil; classify its sites by independent owner/scene depth. This secondary diagnostic separates inherited footprint differences from visibility; not a new geometric coverage truth.
oracle.validation: Known coordinates/depth, negative depth/finite patch controls, exact triangle-ray checks, unchanged raster buffer, reverse face order equality; independently hand-computed closed-form control values.
oracle.point_attribution: Record all dense points: xyz,uv,z,pixel,exact nearest depth/owner,rounded owner depth and scene depth/owner,zpass; report point-coordinate mismatch separately from legitimate rounded-site occlusion and unrounded visibility.
oracle.pixel_attribution: Record pre-z candidate, accepted, width-added, oracle footprint, visible/hidden, corresponding independent plane depths. Report retained visible support and hidden ink leakage together; no count pooling conceals a phase.

metrics.primary_high: Counts and ratio of expected visible ribbon sites with actual >0; false rejection; hidden ribbon ink; ALL actual ink on hidden owner surface including outside ribbon; extra visible footprint; missing despite matchable candidate; no minimum quality gate on unchanged renderer.
metrics.clear_controls: flat points and visible ribbon interior must have nonzero output; overlap scenes points/sites y in[28,36] output are clearly hidden with depth gap>0.5 and must have zero accepted deposits/width ink. Every case has nonempty visible denominator; every overlap case has nonempty hidden and edge denominators.
metrics.edge_band_high: Distance <=4 high-res units (=2 output px) from any front-patch edge or ribbon/owner-patch edge; report separate regions. For thin width1px all ribbon lies in ribbon-edge band: state this explicitly. Occlusion-edge band also reported separately so ribbon-edge exclusion never empties main metric.
metrics.AA: Apply identical uint8->LANCZOS to actual and oracle; save both. Pixel output index j maps to high sample coordinate 2*j+0.5 under resize pixel centers (not 2*j). Report L1, retained reference ink min(actual,ref)/sum(ref), excess ink, and near/deep-occluder bands at these centers; AA tails are not prefilter physical leakage.
metrics.thresholds: Primary ink>0 high; final counts >0 uint8 with sums also reported; no 0.04 support criterion/no threshold search.
metrics.coverage: All20 cases and every phase separately; selected line/plane fixtures only, no object-population claim.
